activity.notes: Al-Hakim bi-Amr Allah was the sixth Fatimid caliph and sixteenth Isma'ili imam from 996 to 1021. The mod's Berbero-Arabia, Arabia and Berbery labels are gameplay categories; ATLAS records the actual Fatimid Caliphate and creates no fictitious Arabia/Berbery reign.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica — ḤĀKEM BE-AMR-ALLĀH
sources.citation_text: Iranica identifies al-Hakim as the sixth Fatimid caliph and sixteenth Isma'ili Imam, reigning 386–411 AH / 996–1021 CE.

sources.title: Institute of Ismaili Studies — al-Hakim bi-Amr Allah
sources.citation_text: The Institute of Ismaili Studies gives the same Fatimid reign, 996–1021.

review_context.requested_identity: AL-HAKIM BI-AMR ALLAH — BERBERO-ARABIA / ARABIA / BERBERY
review_context.correction_note: Normalize all repeated game slots to the single Fatimid caliphate reign.
